Scenario: City repeats Province and Region across 15 rows
Reason: Small compressed dictionaries; no meaningful memory saving, and Region is actually city-grain here.

Scenario: Route needs the month its corridor opened
Reason: Use a separate opening-month dimension at month grain if calendar attributes are needed; avoid an ambiguous path through the shipment-date dimension. If only a label is needed, a Route column is simpler.

Scenario: 50 million customers repeat a 400-character segment description
Reason: Course-intended case 2. Require evidence of high cardinality or poor compression and a measured benefit: a few repeated descriptions would compress well and favor Flatten.

Scenario: Subcategory nightly; manufacturer monthly from another vendor
Reason: Maintain manufacturer attributes at their own grain and load cadence, with stable keys and an explicit history policy.
Use a Shipment–Hazard bridge with unique pairs. Do not duplicate shipment amounts across hazards; allocate or use distinct-shipment filtering when aggregating.

Scenario: City → Province looks tidier in the diagram
Reason: Visual tidiness is not a business grain, ownership, or measured performance requirement.
